XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Learning Paths — replaces BizLMS local_learningplan

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Widened from 254 to 255 in 2026093001 (ADR-032: BizLMS local_learningplan.name is CHAR 255)

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS shortname, kept on imported paths

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): now rendered via the rich-text editor in edit_path form

FIELD.NAME: descriptionformat
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): FORMAT_HTML(1) | FORMAT_PLAIN(2) | FORMAT_MARKDOWN(4)

FIELD.NAME: objective
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS learning objective text

FIELD.NAME: open_path
FIELD.COMMENT: Widened from 254 to 255 in 2026093001 (same width as user.open_path)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=active, 0=archived

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): UNIX ts — path becomes enrollable from this date

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: P1 batch (2026-05-16): UNIX ts — path closes for new enrolments on this date

FIELD.NAME: adaptive_mode
FIELD.COMMENT: P0.2 (2026-06-16): 1=adaptive journey engine active for this path

FIELD.NAME: score_threshold_low
FIELD.COMMENT: P0.2 (2026-06-16): below this quiz percent the engine remediates

FIELD.NAME: score_threshold_high
FIELD.COMMENT: P0.2 (2026-06-16): above this quiz percent the engine accelerates

FIELD.NAME: learning_type
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): 1 = core, 2 = elective (BizLMS learning_type). Stored only.

FIELD.NAME: approvalreqd
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS approval-required flag. Stored only, nothing enforces it (owner decision learningplan.enforce_rules).

FIELD.NAME: selfenrol
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS self-enrolment flag. Stored only, nothing enforces it.

FIELD.NAME: sequential
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS lpsequence, courses are meant to be taken in order. Stored only.

FIELD.NAME: points
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS open_points (shown as credits there). Stored only.

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS open_categoryid, the legacy custom category id (course_lookups keeps those ids)

FIELD.NAME: skillid
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): the skills-feature row the BizLMS open_skill maps to

FIELD.NAME: levelid
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): the skills-feature level the BizLMS open_level maps to

FIELD.NAME: certificateid
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): BizLMS certificate template id. Stored only (certificates map, gap G1, is open).

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): the creator, shown on the path. 0 = unknown. Declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): who last edited the path. 0 = unknown. Declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: is_remedial
FIELD.COMMENT: P0.2 (2026-06-16): 1=remedial node injected by the adaptive engine

FIELD.NAME: is_accelerator
FIELD.COMMENT: P0.2 (2026-06-16): 1=accelerator/branch node

FIELD.NAME: remedial_for_courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: P0.2 (2026-06-16): main course this remedial node supports

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): who put the course on the path. 0 = unknown. Declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): who last changed the row. 0 = unknown. Declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): last change of the row (BizLMS timemodified on imported rows)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=enrolled, 1=in_progress, 2=completed

FIELD.NAME: enrolledby
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): who enrolled the learner. The learner's own id = self-enrolled, 0 = unknown. Declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): last change of the row (BizLMS timemodified on imported rows)

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_lp_course_status
TABLE.COMMENT: ADR-032 (2026093001): per-course status rows of the BizLMS local_plan_course_status table. No reader yet; kept so the rows are not lost.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw BizLMS value. No BizLMS code defines what it means.

FIELD.NAME: percentage
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw BizLMS value. No BizLMS code defines what it means.

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = unknown. Declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = unknown. Declared in the privacy provider.

FIELD.NAME: quiz_score
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz percent 0-100, 2dp (was DECIMALS=0 until 2026092501, which rounded 72.5 to 73)

FIELD.NAME: velocity_score
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion velocity index 0.0-2.0, 2dp (was DECIMALS=0 until 2026092501, which stored only 0, 1 or 2)
